title: Honest breakdown: 6 months solo with Claude Code and Godot, 1,509 tests, 38 wishlists
author: Cookiesaner
selftext:
I posted my game here a few weeks ago (COOKIESANER, a bullet heaven about my real dog, Cookie). Last week the demo got its first big update (0.2.0): Cookie now shoots from a little steel fork, the run comes in ten waves, and level-up cards come in four sizes. So here are the honest numbers and what I learned, in case it helps someone building the same way.

The setup  
\- Solo. Godot 4, GDScript, started end of May, first time ever trying to make a game.  
\- Claude Code writes the code. I make every design call and play each change before I keep it.  
\- Art from Gemini and Higgsfield, then a background removal step on every sprite, because Gemini can't give a transparent background. Music from Suno. SFX also comes from her and are real (barks, pants, growls)

The numbers  
\- 1,612 commits, about 63,000 lines of GDScript (the 0.2.0 build)  
\- 1,509 automatic tests  
\- Free demo since 27 Oct: 20 players on Steam (median play time 11 minutes), plus a browser version on itch  
\- 38 wishlists

What worked  
\- Tests. They run on every change and catch most of what the AI breaks before I even play it. Before them, every fix broke something else.  
\- Several Claude Code sessions at once, each with one job, plus one that plans and checks the others.  
\- Playing every change myself. The AI can't tell if something feels good. 

What didn't  
\- AI walk animation frames. They never matched from frame to frame, so her legs are rigged on single drawings now.  
\- Marketing. Building was the easy part. I skipped October Next Fest with 24 wishlists. Now I'm working towards February.

The game: she fires ćevapi, eats to get bigger, hits harder and moves slower. At stage 4 she goes GOD MODE and rolls over the horde. Two maps, three bosses, about 10 minutes a run.

Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4816480/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=post&utm\_campaign=aigamedev2  
Browser, no download: https://cookiesaner.itch.io/demo

Suggestions and comments about game are welcome :)

comments.author: shaymagen
comments.body: the tests thing is so real, once the AI is writing most of the code they're the only thing keeping it from quietly breaking stuff. curious if the 11 min median on the demo lines up with your 10 min run length or if people are dropping before the first run ends

replies.author: Cookiesaner
replies.body: yeah, tests saved me more times than I can count.  I can't tell because steam only gives me the median and the game doesn't track anything, so 11 min could be one full run or people quitting halfway. Got some playtests lined up to watch that
